From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: validation runbook, success criteria & handoff timeline

Amita —

Thanks for a great conversation this morning. Per our follow-up, attached is a first-cut mutual action plan (MAP) and a short validation runbook that maps the evaluation activities to the acceptance tests and the go/no-go gates. High level:

- Timeline: 6-week evaluation (pilot) window starting Nov 1; two checkpoints (week 2, week 4) and a final acceptance window in week 6.
- Success criteria (scorecard): latency P95 <= 600ms for inference endpoints, intent classification F1 >= 0.88 on the clinical subset, and end-to-end false-positive rate for triage < 6%.
- Exit gates: fail-fast signals at checkpoint if latency exceeds threshold for >5% of requests or concordance on the clinical sample drops by >5 pts vs baseline.
- Acceptance tests: smoke, regression, load, and clinical concordance tests. Details live in the attached evaluation-testcases.json and the MAP spreadsheet (sheet: "Acceptance Tests").

Please review and let us know any compliance evidence or additional test artifacts you need (we can include SOC2 artifact extracts and data flow diagrams in the shared folder). If that looks good, we’ll lock the MAP on Friday and kick off the trial on Nov 1.

Attachments: CuraHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx), evaluation-testcases.json (application/json)

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Appreciate it — if you can update the MAP with the answers, we’ll route to procurement and legal.

Best,
Amita

Amita —

Thanks for the quick review. Answers inline and I attached a revised MAP (v1.1):

1) Data sets: we will run the Nov 10 (week-2) smoke/regression against your 2k high-touch sample and the week-4 and week-6 concordance runs against the full 10k sample. I changed the MAP to reflect: week-2: 2k smoke/regression; week-4: 10k concordance (partial); week-6: 10k final concordance + load.

2) Rollback plan: if concordance at week-4 drops >5 pts vs baseline, we trigger the "pause-and-diagnose" flow:
   - Immediate action: divert traffic to baseline model variant and ring the SRE on-call.
   - Root-cause window: 48 hours for triage, hotfix, or model-variant rollback.
   - Escape hatch: revert inference routing to baseline for production-like traffic and continue narrow-band testing in the evaluation environment.

3) KV cache and PII: we will provide a short artifact (SOC2 excerpt + config snippet) showing the cache bypass flag for PII-tagged requests; uploaded to the shared Drive.

4) Checkpoint scheduling: moved week-2 checkpoint from Nov 9 to Nov 11 to avoid your maintenance window. Updated timeline in MAP v1.1.

Next steps:
- Please confirm by EOD Friday that procurement is OK with the rollback language and the two datasets.
- If confirmed, we’ll lock the MAP and provision the dedicated evaluation pool.

Attachments: CuraHealth_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx), evaluation-testcases.json (application/json)

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
